data.title: Health insurer rejects orthopaedic insoles
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 14 April 2025 that it will not cover the sensorimotor insoles you applied for. It will pay for two pairs of conventional insoles, minus the statutory co-payment.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has rejected your request to pay for sensorimotor insoles. It says they are not in the official list of aids (Hilfsmittelverzeichnis) and their therapeutic benefit is not proven. It will still cover two pairs of conventional insoles, minus the statutory co-payment. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer. The app shows until when. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. You could ask your doctor or a patient advice service for help.
data.tax_note: Unreimbursed medical costs, such as the co-payment or the insoles' cost, may be deductible as extraordinary expenses.

items.title: Objection against rejection
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK in writing, electronically or by recording it in person, if you disagree.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if no objection is filed in time.

key_facts.label: Reason for rejection
key_facts.value: Not in Hilfsmittelverzeichnis; benefit not proven (§ 33 SGB V)
key_facts.quote: Sensomotorische Einlagen sind nicht im Hilfsmittelverzeichnis gelistet; ihr therapeutischer Nutzen ist nicht nachgewiesen (§ 33 SGB V).

key_facts.value: Two pairs of conventional insoles minus co-payment
key_facts.quote: Die Kosten für zwei Paar herkömmliche Einlagen übernehmen wir abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung.
